title: Quick responses and exhaust rust
summary: This topic combines quick system or dealer responses with one clear complaint about early exhaust-system rust, and many excerpts are too brief or mixed in subject to support firmer sentiment labeling.

positive.summary: Positive reviews praise quick acceleration and fast touchscreen response.

negative.summary: Negative feedback describes the exhaust system showing heavy rust very early in ownership.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined excerpts mention quick reactions, battery drain, alerts, dealer handling, and exhaust rust, but the short wording often lacks enough context for a firm sentiment judgment.

limitations: The cluster mixes unrelated subjects such as acceleration, touchscreen response, voice or computer reactions, dealer response, battery behavior, driver alerts, and exhaust rust.
Most excerpts are labeled undetermined and are too brief to reliably summarize sentiment beyond their immediate wording.
The examples are stratified samples and do not support broader conclusions about prevalence or defect rates.
